description: Upsert a platform account on a Dayze Contact (Instagram, Dayze, ChatGPT, …). Multiple accounts per platform are allowed (kind + optional label + is_primary). Pass account_id to update a specific row; otherwise upsert by person+platform+handle+kind. Agents may set status likely|self_reported|unknown (default likely); verified is reserved for server derivation. source is stored as agent. platform=other requires label (site name). ($0.05; API key required)

account_id.description: Optional. Update this person_accounts row instead of upserting by key.

is_primary.description: At most one primary per platform. Setting true unsets the previous primary.

label.description: Free-text note (e.g. photography). Required site name when platform=other.

request_id.description: Client idempotency key (retries return original result).

name: set_person_account

account.description: person_accounts row: id, platform, kind, label, handle, url, status, source, is_primary, linked_profile_id, notes. Multiple accounts per platform allowed.

provenance.description: Which connector wrote the record and which connected Dayze account received it.

account.description: The Dayze account this data belongs to. With more than one Dayze connection, name it in the answer.

note.description: How to disclose the account to the user.

qa_fixture.description: True for a known QA test account: its records are fixture data, not a real life.

name.description: The connected app or API-key label shown to the account owner.

source.description: chatgpt for ChatGPT OAuth writes; mcp for another OAuth app or API key.

title: Set Person Account
